name: Mayo Clinic Hospital Rochester (model)
disclaimer: A model built from public information. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the hospital it describes. Room counts come from public data or stated rules; every room position is inferred (no interior plan was used). Patient flows, staffing and outcomes are simulated, not the hospital's operational data. Staff are fictional.

site.note: Schematic site: the rectangle is fitted around the generated rooms; roads are illustrative. No map data was used.
